cancellation: Cancellations are not permitted unless Trip Protection is purchased at the time of booking. With Trip Protection, you may cancel up to 2 hours before your scheduled tour for a full refund. No-shows or late arrivals without Trip Protection will be charged the full booking amount.
policies: On the day of rental, a security deposit will be held on your credit card until the GoCar is returned.
With Trip Protection, you may cancel up to 2 hours before your scheduled tour for a full refund.
GoCar Tours reserves the right to reschedule or refund tours in the event of severe weather, safety concerns, or unforeseen circumstances.
The tours usually run in light rain and other moderate weather conditions, as light rain usually passes quickly in Monterey.
We will cancel tours up to an hour before the start time in the event of severe or unsafe weather conditions.

faq.q: Do I have to purchase tickets in advance?
faq.a: Booking in advance is highly recommended. Please book early to maximize your chances of getting the day and time you prefer. Tickets can be purchased online or over the phone.
